title: How often economies at India's relative position crossed the upper-middle line
sourceIndicatorId: NY.GNP.PCAP.CD + historical analytical classifications and thresholds

metadata.revisionWarning: The 2025 values are estimates and may be revised.
metadata.rounding: Displayed values should be rounded; derived ratios retain one decimal place.
metadata.method: Kaplan-Meier cumulative first-crossing estimate. Entry is the first observed post-1987 lower-middle-income year at 55-65% of the upper-middle threshold; economies not crossing by 2025 are right-censored.
metadata.warning: This is historical experience across heterogeneous economies, not India's probability or forecast.
